prompt: By noon, I ___ (work) on this proposal for six hours.
explanation: For six hours mide la duración acumulada del trabajo hasta el mediodía.

prompt: Next January, the research team ___ (run) the clinical trial for eighteen months.
explanation: La actividad continuará y habrá acumulado dieciocho meses en enero.

prompt: When the launch window opens, the engineers ___ (not / test) the prototype under polar conditions for a full year.
explanation: La negativa indica que, al abrirse la ventana de lanzamiento, las pruebas aún no acumularán un año.

prompt: How long ___ (you / oversee) the merger by the time the regulators issue their decision?
explanation: How long pregunta por la duración acumulada hasta una decisión futura.

prompt: By morning, will it have been ___ (rain) continuously for twelve hours?
explanation: will it have been fija la cadena interrogativa; tras been se usa el verbo en -ing.

prompt: By next month, she will not have been ___ (use) the platform continuously for a full quarter.
explanation: will not have been fija la cadena negativa; continuously destaca el proceso acumulado.

prompt: When the vessel docks in Cape Town, the crew ___ (sail) continuously for forty days.
explanation: For forty days expresa cuánto habrá durado la travesía continua al llegar a puerto.

prompt: The analysts will have been monitoring the market for six months by then.
solution: The analysts will not have been monitoring the market for six months by then.
explanation: Not se coloca después de will; la cadena have been monitoring no cambia.

prompt: The legal teams will have been negotiating for a year when the licence expires.
solution: Will the legal teams have been negotiating for a year when the licence expires?
explanation: Will pasa delante del sujeto y el resto de la cadena verbal conserva su orden.

prompt: By July, the observatory will have been tracking the comet for twelve consecutive months.
explanation: For twelve consecutive months destaca la duración acumulada del seguimiento hasta julio.

prompt: By sunset, they will have been repairing the pipeline for ten hours, but the work will still not be complete.
explanation: El trabajo seguirá incompleto y el foco recae en las diez horas de proceso acumulado.

prompt: When the tribunal reconvenes, the lawyers will have been negotiating behind closed doors all week.
explanation: All week mide una negociación sostenida hasta el momento futuro en que se reúna de nuevo el tribunal.
